retrievalProfile.description: A gritty glam-rock aesthetic featuring a leather-clad subject with high-contrast textures and layered, aggressive typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a figure in a heavily studded black leather jacket and a skull-motif t-shirt, set against a neutral textured background with a dynamic, two-layered typographic lockup in the upper right.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark, textured leather contrasts against the flat, neutral grey background.
The bright, blocky background text provides a foundation for the aggressive, red script overlay.
The intricate details of the studs and skull graphic draw the eye to the center-left before moving to the top-right text.
The downward-looking pose creates a sense of moody introspection typical of rock portraiture.
coreInvariants: High-contrast metallic studs on black leather
Layered typography with a blocky base and a script overlay

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned on the left half of the frame, medium-full shot from waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The studded leather jacket and the central skull graphic on the t-shirt.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's face/hair, moves down the jacket details, then jumps to the bright typographic lockup in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the right side of the frame to accommodate the title text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Blood Red (script text) and Cream (block text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the metallic studs and the black leather.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to desaturated tones with one primary warm accent

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy sans-serif block and aggressive brush script
letterConstructionRules: Base text uses ultra-bold, condensed geometric forms with slight perspective tilting.
Overlay text uses irregular, jagged strokes mimicking hand-painted or blood-dripped lettering.
The two layers must overlap to create a sense of depth and 'vandalism'.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Terminals on the script text are elongated and tapered to look like drips.
Block letters have slightly rounded corners to suggest a vintage print feel.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive contrast between stable, heavy geometric blocks and chaotic, organic script.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary blocky, condensed foundation for the base text.
Captures the jagged, aggressive energy of the overlay text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a person with long dark curly hair wearing a black leather jacket covered in silver metal studs and a t-shirt with a large skull graphic, standing against a grainy grey studio wall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large cream-colored blocky sans-serif title in the upper right at a 15-degree tilt, then overlay a jagged red brush-script word across the center of the blocky text.

verificationChecks: Is the block text tilted and condensed?
Does the red script look hand-painted and aggressive?
Is the leather jacket texture highly detailed with visible studs?
Is the subject positioned to the left to allow for text on the right?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific artist names
Do not replicate exact logo shapes
Ensure the skull graphic is a generic artistic interpretation
postGenerationChecks: Check that the red text is legible despite the overlap.
Ensure the studs have a metallic sheen.
Verify the background remains neutral and non-distracting.
Confirm the composition feels balanced between the subject and the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject(Rock Persona) + Texture(Studded Leather) + Layout(Asymmetric) + Typography(Block Base + Script Overlay)
